subject: Board nod requested: VentureBridge Hosted API rate concession
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@venturebridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing — proposed concession and next steps

Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, VentureBridge is evaluating a 12-month committed usage plan tied to the hosted API (est. 18M tokens/month initial ramp). To hit their internal targets they asked us to consider a deeper concession than our standard thresholds.

Summary of our ask to the exec team:
- Request: one-time committed discount of 28% off list hosted-API unit price for 12 months
- Minimums: 12-month term, 50% prepay at signing, monthly usage reporting, quarterly business review
- Strategic rationale: white-label integration across three product lines; strong likelihood of expansion to dedicated capacity in 2028; testimonial / case study for venture-backed fintech segment

Attached: updated term sheet (VB_term_sheet_v3.pdf) and usage forecast (VB_usage_forecast_Q4-2027.xlsx). Deal ID VB-2027-042.

Ben and Marissa are copied; I’d like to get senior signoff for anything >20%. If you can approve the concession, I’ll route for Mina’s signoff today and provide a DocuSign link.

Samir — are there any legal/procurement constraints on your side we should pre-check?

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199

Attachments: VB_term_sheet_v3.pdf (application/pdf), VB_usage_forecast_Q4-2027.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — proposed concession and next steps

Jordan,

Thanks for capturing — I support taking a concession here because VentureBridge is strategic for vaulting into the fintech vertical. A few internal notes for the exec packet:
- ARR impact (first 12 months): ~$1.2M net after concession, 40%+ YoY upside if expansion executes
- Risk: higher than-normal usage variability in month 1; recommend a usage floor and an overage price tier to protect unit economics

Marissa — can you confirm S&M credit and whether we can offer a short-term rebate tied to usage milestones (e.g., additional 3% credit after hitting 125% forecast for 3 consecutive months)?

Ben
VP, Sales Operations
ben.carter@redwood.com

> On Sep 1, 2027, at 9:12 AM, Jordan Blake wrote:
> > [original message]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — proposed concession and next steps

Folks,

Reviewed the packet. I can approve up to a 25% concession under the following binding conditions:
- 12-month firm term
- 50% prepay at signature; remainder billed monthly in arrears
- Usage floor at 60% of forecast; below-floor triggers a review and potential shortfall recovery
- SLA: 99.9% uptime, incident response within 1 hour for Sev1

Jordan, if you want 28% you need formal exec approval (Mina). Ben — I support the milestone rebate (3%) as a post-facto credit, not an upfront reduction.

Marissa Cole
Head of Deal Desk
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
On Sep 1, 2027, at 10:03 AM, Ben Carter wrote:
> [internal note]
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API pricing — proposed concession and next steps

Team,

I reviewed VB-2027-042 and the attached forecast. I approve a one-time 28% concession for the 12-month hosted-API commitment with these executive conditions:
1) 50% prepayment at signing; remaining billed monthly
2) Legal to accept our standard data-use and indemnity terms (no bespoke changes without Legal PM approval)
3) A quarterly business review and joint case study agreement (marketing opt-in)
4) If actual usage drops below 50% of forecast for two consecutive months, Redwood can revert pricing to the 25% concession tier for the remainder of the term

This approval is contingent on Legal and Finance confirming the prepay mechanism and SOC2 evidence checklist (already requested). Jordan — route the DocuSign and copy me on the signature packet.

Mina Haddad
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

> On Sep 1, 2027, at 11:27 AM, Marissa Cole wrote:
> > [deal desk conditions]
From: Samir Patel <samir@venturebridge.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Varga <elena.v@venturebridge.io>, procurement@venturebridge.io
Date: 2027-09-03T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — proposed concession and next steps

Jordan,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity. I confirm VentureBridge accepts the 28% concession under Mina’s conditions. Procurement will review the DocuSign with our legal team; please send the final DocuSign link and the term sheet with the conditional SLA and case study clause clearly marked.

Samir
Head of Partnerships, VentureBridge
samir@venturebridge.io
